messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error + qps spike on /v1/embeddings (eu-west, us-east) - possible credential stuffing pattern detected. Paging oncall.
alice.ops: paging @ben-sre and @dani-eng — top-level oncall please ack.
ben-sre: acked. I'm in. looking at ingress: large fanout from ~120k unique IPs, bursts to embeddings async queue. signs of automated scraping.
dani-eng: confirming. KV cache churning, Redis connection saturation on embed-worker pool. need to reduce fanout asap.
alice.ops: proposed mitigation plan: 1) enable WAF rule block (signature id 56071) for offending UA pattern 2) apply geo-rate-slice for eu-west/us-east 3) disable async embeddings write queue (fallback to sync failures) 4) notify CX for top customers impacted.
ben-sre: doing 1 & 2 now. WAF rule enabled via wafctl: wafctl rules enable 56071 --scope=global
ben-sre: applied geo-rate-slice: /admin/rate-slice set --path /v1/embeddings --regions eu-west,us-east --slice 0.15
dani-eng: turning off async embeddings worker flag: ENV EMBED_ASYNC_ENABLED=false -> rolling restart embed-worker autoset. Command: kubectl set env deploy/embed-worker EMBED_ASYNC_ENABLED=false -n prod
carla-pm: quick ask — any paying customers likely to hit errors? need list to prep comms.
eric-support: checking customers with high embed QPS. pulling list... (2m)
eric-support: P1: example-inc (high), vendor-x (medium). adding to incident doc.
alice.ops: also temp bump quota for example-inc to avoid impacting paid usage while we mitigate: quota adjust example-inc +20% until 4176544200
ben-sre: confirming backend circuit: adding short-term circuit breaker on embed proxy for fanout > 8 requests/s per token: proxyctl set-circuit embed-proxy --threshold 8 --ttl 30s
dani-eng: watch loops: disabled async queue, WAF in place, geo-slice active, circuit breaker deployed. Redis connections falling.
ben-sre: metrics look better: 60% drop in async queue backlog in last 90s. errors 502 -> 200 trending.
eric-support: flagged example-inc & vendor-x with postmortem notice draft. Carla, want me to send interim note?
carla-pm: yes please — short note: we saw unusual automated traffic, mitigations applied, potential intermittent embed errors, we'll follow up with root cause and timeline.
alice.ops: ownership: ben-sre lead on infra mitigation, dani-eng lead for embed-service config and post-mitigation restore, eric-support owner for customer comms. tagging incident as SECURITY-INVEST.
ben-sre: continuing to monitor. leaving a hook for rollback once queue drained: kubectl set env deploy/embed-worker EMBED_ASYNC_ENABLED=true -n prod
dani-eng: we'll only re-enable after stable 10m window under thresholds. leaving locks in config repo.
alice.ops: thanks team. logging steps into incident tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3819
incident-bot: Incident INF-3819 created and paged. Timeline recorded. :white_check_mark:
